name: Quiet Flame
lyrics: [Intro]
[Verse 1]
Every evening when the lights turn low
There's a corner booth that only we know
Your coffee's cold, but your eyes are warm
We steal an hour from a world of storms
[Pre-Chorus]
Nobody sees, nobody knows
Just a little piano and the rain outside the window
[Chorus]
Oh, you and me, this quiet flame
We never say each other's name
It ain't right, but it feels so real
Baby, I can't hide the way I feel
[Verse 2]
You got a ring and I got mine
We keep on living on borrowed time
I hold your hand beneath the table
Wish I could love you more than I'm able
[Chorus]
Oh, you and me, this quiet flame
We never say each other's name
It ain't right, but it feels so real
Baby, I can't hide the way I feel
[Bridge]
When the clock strikes seven, you gotta go
I watch you leave, and my heart moves slow
Tomorrow evening, I'll be waiting there
Just one more hour, one more hour to share
[Chorus]
Oh, you and me, this quiet flame
We never say each other's name
It ain't right, but it feels so real
Baby, I can't hide the way I feel
[Outro]
This quiet flame, ooh, this quiet flame
Don't let it go, don't let it go
